title: Miami-Dade County Referendum 2: One-Year District Residency to Run for County Commission
what_it_does: County ballot question (Yes / No). Passes with a simple majority of votes cast on the question.
ballot_summary: Charter Amendment Increase Length of District Residency to Run for County Commissioner. Shall the Charter be amended to change the residency requirement for Commission members, increasing the minimum time a candidate must reside within their district from six months to one year before the start of the qualifying period?
what_yes_means: A YES vote requires county commission candidates to have lived in their district for at least one year before qualifying begins, instead of six months.
what_no_means: A NO vote keeps the six-month district residency requirement.
verified_ballot_note: Official wording copied from the Miami-Dade County Supervisor of Elections' final General Election master ballot (https://www.miamidade.gov/elections/library/2026-11-03-general-election-master-ballot.pdf, fetched Sept. 18, 2026).
